hero.headline: Clear numbers for growing companies.
hero.subheadline: Fractional CFO and operations support for founder-led businesses between $2M and $50M in revenue.

content.intro_md:
Northline is a team of twelve former finance leaders from high-growth companies. We work with a small number of clients at a time so every engagement gets a senior lead.

We're independent, we don't sell software, and we won't recommend a hire you don't need.

features.title: Fractional CFO
features.body_md: Board reporting, fundraising support and strategic planning, two days a month.

features.title: Monthly close
features.body_md: Reconciled books and management accounts by the fifth working day.

features.title: Cash forecasting
features.body_md: A rolling 13-week forecast you'll actually open.

features.title: Systems & process
features.body_md: Pick, implement and connect the right finance stack.
